samples.title: [NET-P001] What is the default port number of HTTP?
samples.explanation: The standard default port for HTTP is 80. HTTP is used for Hypertext Transfer Protocol (unencrypted World Wide Web traffic), operating primarily over transport protocol TCP.

samples.title: [NET-P002] Which protocol uses default port 80?
samples.explanation: Port 80 is the well-known port assigned by IANA to HTTP. It handles Hypertext Transfer Protocol (unencrypted World Wide Web traffic) using transport layer TCP.

samples.title: [NET-P004] Which protocol uses default port 443?
samples.explanation: Port 443 is the well-known port assigned by IANA to HTTPS. It handles Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTP over TLS/SSL encryption) using transport layer TCP.

samples.title: [NET-P006] Which protocol uses default port 21?
samples.explanation: Port 21 is the well-known port assigned by IANA to FTP (control). It handles File Transfer Protocol (Command/Control Connection) using transport layer TCP.

samples.title: [NET-P008] Which protocol uses default port 22?
samples.explanation: Port 22 is the well-known port assigned by IANA to SSH. It handles Secure Shell (Encrypted remote login and secure file transfer) using transport layer TCP.

samples.title: [SQL-P002] What is the output of the following SQL?
